duplicate_search_result: No exact matching GitHub or Gitee issue found for WhileLoop Graph mode failing when a locally defined cond_func or loop_func uses Tensor constants.
documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9 WhileLoop docs list CPU support and describe init_val as Union[Tensor, number, str, bool, list, tuple, dict].
The documented syntactic limitations mention side effects and loop_func returning a different type or shape from init_val; the failing cases satisfy these constraints.
The same Tensor scalar carry passes when local cond_func and loop_func use Python constants.
The same Tensor constant passes when the WhileLoop callbacks are defined at module level.
Plain nested functions, ForiLoop, and Scan controls using scalar Tensor constants pass in Graph mode, localizing the failure to WhileLoop's handling of Tensor constants in the supplied functions.
classification_notes: Not a numerical precision issue: Graph mode fails during static analysis with ValueError before producing numeric output.
Not a CPU unsupported issue: WhileLoop documents CPU support, and the Python-constant and tuple-carry controls pass on CPU.
Not a general local-function Graph parser limitation: a plain local Tensor-constant function compiles and runs in Graph mode.
The observed Graph error is an internal static-analysis failure: 'The object is not callable' with a DeadNode FuncGraph call site.
